title: H1243 (2020 Regular): Domestic Violence

other_topics: judicial-criminal-justice: Section 3 (s. 901.02, F.S.) — lets a court issue an arrest warrant for an act of domestic violence

operative_text:
Section 1 (s. 741.2901, F.S.): If a defendant is arrested for an act of domestic violence, the court must order the defendant not to possess a firearm or any ammunition as a condition of bail if the court finds that the safety of the victim, the victim's children, or others will likely be more adequately assured.
Section 1 (s. 741.2901, F.S.): (4) Notwithstanding subsection (3), an individual with an outstanding warrant issued pursuant to s. 901.02(3) is prohibited from possessing a firearm or any ammunition.
Section 2 (s. 790.065, F.S.): 4. Has been arrested for an act of domestic violence and is prohibited from possessing a firearm or any ammunition under s. 741.2901(3) or has an outstanding warrant issued pursuant to s. 901.02(3) and is prohibited from possessing a firearm or any ammunition; or
